_meta: Single source of truth for strategy parameters that used to be declared twice: once as an MQL5 `input` default in mt5/Experts/XauAssistant.mq5, once as a module constant in scripts/backtest.py. The EA inputs are the LIVE authority -- this file must match them, not the other way around. service/tests/test_strategy_config.py::test_strategy_config_matches_the_ea enforces that match on every run (numeric compare, so 50 and 50.0 agree). `shared` holds the TradeManager/RiskManager parameters that apply no matter which registered strategy is ActiveStrategy (there is only one set of these EA inputs -- they are not duplicated per strategy). `strategies` holds the per-instance HalfTrend parameters that DO differ between the M5 lane (halftrend_ema_v1) and the M15 lane (halftrend_m15_v1); each block mirrors that lane's own EA inputs. Do not add a key here without wiring it into both the EA input table above the test and the backtest loader in scripts/backtest.py -- an unmapped key fails the completeness check in the same test file.
